sync-docs.title: Sync Docs
sync-docs.description: Pre-PR step: review strad's documentation against the branch diff and update whatever has gone stale — README.md, AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, docs/, HACKS.md, strad.config.example.yaml — so docs ship in the same PR and never drift from code. Default, always-on: run it as the final routine before opening a PR. Vendored copy of the central Reframe sync-docs skill, adapted to strad's documentation surface.

strad-deploy-staging.title: Deploy strad to Staging
strad-deploy-staging.description: Deploy a strad change to the staging environment. The `Deploy staging` workflow deploys a published image tag (ghcr.io/tadasant/strad:<version>, default latest) to the strad-staging App Platform app rendered from infra/strad.staging.yaml, and staging is ON DEMAND — merging to main does not deploy it and teardown-staging.yml archives it nightly, so the only path is a manual workflow_dispatch, which either re-pins staging to an existing tag (rollback) or, with build:true, builds the dispatched BRANCH into branch-scoped core and bundle images and deploys those. Covers dispatching the run, deploying an unmerged branch and restoring main, the nightly archive and how to wake staging from it, the App-Platform full-replace hazard, verifying the public 401-gated host, rollback, and what an agent session can and cannot do without DO/GCP credentials. Production is NOT deployed from this repo — it lives in tadasant-internal.
